chain_contractBootstrapRequired.en: Your account isn't set up yet. Try again later.
chain_contractBootstrapRequired.zh: 账号尚未完成初始化，请稍后重试。

chain_contractCancelled.en: The request was cancelled and the result is unknown. Check the latest status before deciding whether to retry.
chain_contractCancelled.zh: 请求已被取消，结果未知。请查看最新状态后再决定是否重试。

chain_contractChainMismatch.en: This chain isn't supported: Wallet, Market, Swap and approvals run on BNB Smart Chain; Launch runs on the Launch chain published by LOOP.
chain_contractChainMismatch.zh: 这条链现在不支持：钱包、行情、兑换与授权都在 BNB Smart Chain 上，Launch 在 LOOP 发布的 Launch 链上。

chain_contractIdempotencyConflict.en: The same action was already submitted with different content. Check the latest status and try again.
chain_contractIdempotencyConflict.zh: 同一操作已被提交过且内容不同，请检查最新状态后再试。

chain_contractIndexingDelayed.en: On-chain records are still syncing. They can't be read right now; that doesn't mean there are none.
chain_contractIndexingDelayed.zh: 链上记录还在同步，这里是暂时读不到，不是没有记录。

chain_contractInsufficientBalance.en: Balance doesn't cover this amount, the maximum network fee or the fee reserve. No transaction was submitted.
chain_contractInsufficientBalance.zh: 余额不足以覆盖这笔金额、最高网络费或手续费保留，没有提交任何交易。

chain_contractInvalidData.en: The returned data was incomplete. Nothing on this page was used.
chain_contractInvalidData.zh: 返回的数据不完整，这一页没有采用任何内容。

chain_contractNotFound.en: The target doesn't exist, isn't registered, or isn't visible to this account.
chain_contractNotFound.zh: 目标不存在、未登记，或对当前账号不可见。

chain_contractOffline.en: This device is offline. Nothing was loaded on this page and no action was submitted.
chain_contractOffline.zh: 设备已离线，这一页没有读到数据，也没有提交任何操作。

chain_contractOutcomeUnknown.en: The returned data was incomplete and the result isn't confirmed. Refresh to see the latest status; don't submit again.
chain_contractOutcomeUnknown.zh: 返回的数据不完整，结果未确认。请刷新查看最新状态，不要重复提交。

chain_contractPermissionDenied.en: This account doesn't have permission for this action.
chain_contractPermissionDenied.zh: 当前账号没有执行这个操作的权限。

chain_contractQuoteExpired.en: The quote has expired. No swap was submitted. Get a new quote before confirming.
chain_contractQuoteExpired.zh: 报价已过期，没有提交任何兑换。请重新报价后再确认。

chain_contractRateLimited.en: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
chain_contractRateLimited.zh: 请求过于频繁，请稍等片刻再试。

chain_contractReadFailed.en: This page can't be loaded right now. Nothing was submitted. Try again later.
chain_contractReadFailed.zh: 这一页暂时读不到，没有提交任何内容。请稍后重试。

chain_contractRegionBlocked.en: This action isn't available in your region right now. Nothing was changed. This isn't related to your account or assets, and switching won't change the result.
chain_contractRegionBlocked.zh: 你所在的地区暂时不支持这个操作，没有发生任何变化。这与账号或资产无关，换一个也不会改变结果。

chain_contractSimulationFailed.en: This transaction didn't pass simulation and can't be signed. Go back to the confirmation page and prepare it again.
chain_contractSimulationFailed.zh: 这笔交易试算没有通过，不能签名。请返回确认页重新准备一次。

chain_contractStale.en: Data may be out of date

chain_contractStepUpCancelled.zh: 已取消，没有发生任何变化。

chain_contractStepUpRequired.en: This step requires two-step verification, which isn't available yet. Nothing was changed.
chain_contractStepUpRequired.zh: 这一步需要二次验证，二次验证还没有开放，没有发生任何变化。

chain_contractSubmissionUnknown.en: This action was already submitted once and the result is unknown, so it's locked. Only check the latest status; don't submit again.
chain_contractSubmissionUnknown.zh: 这笔操作已经提交过一次且结果未知，已锁定。请只查看最新状态，不要重复提交。

chain_contractSwitch.en: On-chain data can't be loaded right now.

chain_contractSwitch10.en: The balance wasn't loaded this time, so no number is shown.
chain_contractSwitch10.zh: 这次余额没有读到，因此不显示数字。

chain_contractSwitch11.en: Transfer history can't be loaded right now.

chain_contractSwitch12.en: Trades and candlesticks can't be loaded right now.
chain_contractSwitch12.zh: 成交与 K 线暂时读不到。

chain_contractSwitch13.en: BNB transfer history can't be loaded right now.
chain_contractSwitch13.zh: BNB 转账记录暂时读不到。

chain_contractSwitch14.en: Bridge and mining claim history can't be loaded right now.
chain_contractSwitch14.zh: 跨链与挖矿领取记录暂时读不到。

chain_contractSwitch15.en: MEME records on the Launch chain haven't started syncing; only transfers are listed below.
chain_contractSwitch15.zh: Launch 链的 MEME 记录还没有开始同步，下面只列出转账。

chain_contractSwitch16.en: MEME records weren't loaded this time; only transfers are listed below. Check back later.
chain_contractSwitch16.zh: MEME 记录这次没有读到，下面只列出转账，稍后再看。

chain_contractSwitch17.en: This asset can't be reconciled with wallet records.
chain_contractSwitch17.zh: 这个资产无法与钱包记录核对。

chain_contractSwitch18.en: External wallets can't be reconciled with wallet records.
chain_contractSwitch18.zh: 外部钱包无法与钱包记录核对。

chain_contractSwitch19.en: Balance reconciliation failed; on-chain figures aren't affected.
chain_contractSwitch19.zh: 余额核对没有成功，链上数字不受影响。

chain_contractSwitch2.en: On-chain data isn't available right now. Try again later.
chain_contractSwitch2.zh: 链上数据暂时不可用，稍后再试。

chain_contractSwitch20.en: Swap isn't available yet; this page has no buy or sell entry.
chain_contractSwitch20.zh: 兑换还没有开放，这一页没有买卖入口。

chain_contractSwitch21.en: This asset can no longer be loaded. The row is kept so you can remove it.
chain_contractSwitch21.zh: 这个资产已经读不到，保留这一行方便你移除。

chain_contractSwitch22.en: This address isn't in the LOOP asset catalog. The data below comes from a market data source and can't be traded.
chain_contractSwitch22.zh: 这个地址不在 LOOP 资产目录里，下面的数据来自行情数据源，不能买卖。

chain_contractSwitch24.en: Market data isn't available right now. Try again later.
chain_contractSwitch24.zh: 行情暂时不可用，稍后再试。

chain_contractSwitch25.en: Price can't be loaded right now, so no value is shown.
chain_contractSwitch25.zh: 暂时读不到价格，不显示估值。

chain_contractSwitch26.en: DexScreener data is currently turned off.

chain_contractSwitch27.en: Security info and holder count can't be loaded right now.
chain_contractSwitch27.zh: 安全信息与持有人数暂时读不到。

chain_contractSwitch28.en: New token discovery and related market data can't be loaded right now.
chain_contractSwitch28.zh: 新币发现与相关行情暂时读不到。

chain_contractSwitch29.en: The data service is rate limited; no new figures for now.
chain_contractSwitch29.zh: 数据服务限流中，暂时没有新数值。

chain_contractSwitch3.en: Checking the on-chain connection; on-chain figures are hidden for now.
chain_contractSwitch3.zh: 正在校验链上连接，暂时不显示链上数字。

chain_contractSwitch30.en: The data service rejected this request. It isn't your network. Check back later.
chain_contractSwitch30.zh: 数据服务拒绝了这次请求，与你的网络无关，稍后再看。

chain_contractSwitch31.en: Market data can't be loaded right now, so this item has no value. Check back later.
chain_contractSwitch31.zh: 行情数据暂时读不到，这一项没有数值，稍后再看。

chain_contractSwitch32.en: Market data can't be fetched right now. It isn't your network. Check back later.
chain_contractSwitch32.zh: 行情暂时取不到，与你的网络无关，稍后再看。

chain_contractSwitch33.en: The returned data was incomplete and was discarded.
chain_contractSwitch33.zh: 返回的数据不完整，已整体丢弃。

chain_contractSwitch34.en: No trading pair found for this asset.
chain_contractSwitch34.zh: 没有找到这个资产的交易对。

chain_contractSwitch35.en: The data source didn't report this item.
chain_contractSwitch35.zh: 数据源没有报告这一项。

chain_contractSwitch36.en: Native BNB has no contract address, so this item doesn't apply.
chain_contractSwitch36.zh: 原生 BNB 没有合约地址，这一项不适用。

chain_contractSwitch37.en: This asset has no PancakeSwap V3 pool yet.
chain_contractSwitch37.zh: 这个资产还没有 PancakeSwap V3 交易池。

chain_contractSwitch38.en: No trades in the selected range.

chain_contractSwitch39.en: This row's balance can't be loaded, so it can't be valued.
chain_contractSwitch39.zh: 这一行余额读不到，无法估值。

chain_contractSwitch4.en: Can't reach the on-chain node right now. It isn't your network. Check back later.
chain_contractSwitch4.zh: 链上节点暂时连不上，与你的网络无关，稍后再看。

chain_contractSwitch5.en: Not connected to BNB Smart Chain; this page is unavailable.
chain_contractSwitch5.zh: 连接到的不是 BNB Smart Chain，这一页不可用。

chain_contractSwitch6.en: Launch chain data can't be loaded right now.
chain_contractSwitch6.zh: Launch 链上数据暂时读不到。

chain_contractSwitch7.en: Checking the Launch chain connection; on-chain figures are hidden for now.
chain_contractSwitch7.zh: 正在校验 Launch 链连接，暂时不显示链上数字。

chain_contractSwitch8.en: Can't reach the Launch chain node right now. It isn't your network. Check back later.
chain_contractSwitch8.zh: Launch 链节点暂时连不上，与你的网络无关，稍后再看。

chain_contractSwitch9.en: Not connected to the Launch chain; Launch content is unavailable.
chain_contractSwitch9.zh: 连接到的不是 Launch 链，Launch 相关内容不可用。

chain_contractText.en: Holder distribution can't be loaded right now.
chain_contractText.zh: 持有人分布暂时读不到。

chain_contractText10.en: Fund actions aren't available right now. Try again later.
chain_contractText10.zh: 资金操作暂时不可用，稍后再试。

chain_contractText11.en: On-chain actions are currently turned off; view only for now.
chain_contractText11.zh: 链上操作当前已关闭，现在只能查看。

chain_contractText12.en: Swap isn't available right now. Try again later.
chain_contractText12.zh: 兑换暂时不可用，稍后再试。

chain_contractText13.en: Swap is still being verified. You can view quotes but can't execute.
chain_contractText13.zh: 兑换还在验证中，可以查看报价，但不能执行。

chain_contractText14.en: Swap can't be simulated right now, so it can't be executed.
chain_contractText14.zh: 兑换暂时无法试算，因此不能执行。

chain_contractText15.en: Can't check whether this address is on known scam lists right now. That doesn't mean it's safe.
chain_contractText15.zh: 暂时无法核对这个地址是否在已知诈骗名单里。这不代表它安全。

chain_contractText16.en: Approval risk info can't be loaded right now.
chain_contractText16.zh: 授权风险信息暂时读不到。

chain_contractText17.en: This row's approval amount can't be loaded, so no number is shown.
chain_contractText17.zh: 这一行的授权额度读不到，因此不显示数字。

chain_contractText18.en: This transaction was rejected on-chain during simulation and can't be signed.
chain_contractText18.zh: 这笔交易试算时被链上拒绝，不能签名。

chain_contractText19.en: Simulation returned no verifiable result, so it can't be signed.
chain_contractText19.zh: 试算没有返回可核对的结果，不能签名。

chain_contractText2.en: Smart money tracking isn't available yet.
chain_contractText2.zh: 聪明钱追踪还没有开放。

chain_contractText20.en: Can't estimate the network fee, so no signable transaction can be built.
chain_contractText20.zh: 无法估算网络费，因此不能构造可签名的交易。

chain_contractText21.en: This action has expired. Prepare it again.
chain_contractText21.zh: 这次操作已过期，请重新准备一次。

chain_contractText22.en: This wallet has prepared a new action; this one was replaced and not submitted.
chain_contractText22.zh: 这个钱包已经准备了新的操作，这一笔被取代，没有提交。

chain_contractText23.en: You cancelled this action. No transaction was submitted.
chain_contractText23.zh: 这次操作已由你取消，没有提交任何交易。

chain_contractText24.en: The transaction was submitted but isn't on-chain yet. LOOP will keep checking.
chain_contractText24.zh: 交易已提交，链上还没有查到，LOOP 会继续核对。

chain_contractText25.en: The submitted transaction didn't match what was prepared and was rejected.
chain_contractText25.zh: 提交的交易与准备好的内容不一致，已拒绝。

chain_contractText26.en: The transaction is on-chain but failed; the network fee was spent.
chain_contractText26.zh: 交易已上链但执行失败，网络费已消耗。

chain_contractText27.en: The transaction receipt can't be loaded right now; the result is pending.
chain_contractText27.zh: 交易回执暂时读不到，结果待确认。

chain_contractText28.en: The wallet rejected this swap. Nothing was submitted on-chain.
chain_contractText28.zh: 钱包拒绝了这次兑换，没有提交到链上。

chain_contractText29.en: The result of this action isn't certain yet. Wait for confirmation; don't submit again.
chain_contractText29.zh: 这次操作的结果还不确定，请等待确认，不要重复提交。

chain_contractText3.en: Push notifications aren't available yet; alerts only appear in the in-app notification list.
chain_contractText3.zh: 推送还没有开放，提醒只出现在应用内的通知列表里。

chain_contractText30.en: Price impact is over 5%; this swap was blocked.
chain_contractText30.zh: 价格影响超过 5%，已阻止这笔兑换。

chain_contractText31.en: Can't calculate the price impact of this swap, so it was blocked.
chain_contractText31.zh: 无法计算这笔兑换的价格影响，已阻止。

chain_contractText32.en: This action can't go to wallet signing right now.
chain_contractText32.zh: 这笔操作暂时无法进入钱包签名。

chain_contractText33.en: This chain doesn't support this action: Send, approvals, revokes and Swap only work on mainnet.
chain_contractText33.zh: 这条链不支持这个操作：发送、授权、回收与兑换只能在主网进行。

chain_contractText35.en: Security settings aren't available right now. Try again later.
chain_contractText35.zh: 安全设置暂时不可用，稍后再试。

chain_contractText37.en: Settings aren't available right now. Try again later.
chain_contractText37.zh: 设置暂时不可用，稍后再试。

chain_contractText39.en: Support isn't available right now. Try again later.
chain_contractText39.zh: 客服暂时不可用，稍后再试。

chain_contractText4.en: No community has linked this asset yet.
chain_contractText4.zh: 还没有社区绑定这个资产。

chain_contractText40.en: The device list can't be loaded right now.

chain_contractText41.en: Recent security events can't be loaded right now.
chain_contractText41.zh: 最近的安全事件暂时读不到。

chain_contractText42.en: Two-step verification is required, but it isn't available yet.
chain_contractText42.zh: 需要二次验证，二次验证还没有开放。

chain_contractText43.en: Tickets can't take attachments right now.
chain_contractText43.zh: 工单暂时不能上传附件。

chain_contractText44.en: Legal document links can't be opened right now.
chain_contractText44.zh: 法律文件链接暂时打不开。

chain_contractText45.en: The new terms haven't taken effect yet.

chain_contractText46.en: Version and build number come from this device.
chain_contractText46.zh: 版本与构建号来自这台设备。

chain_contractText48.en: The approval list can't be loaded right now.

chain_contractText49.en: The approval list isn't available yet.

chain_contractText5.en: Per-asset mining figures aren't available yet; power and details are on the Mining page.
chain_contractText5.zh: 按资产拆分的挖矿数字暂未开放；算力与明细在挖矿页。

chain_contractText50.en: On-chain records are still syncing; the approval list can't be loaded right now.
chain_contractText50.zh: 链上记录还在同步，授权列表暂时读不到。

chain_contractText51.en: This feature isn't available right now.

chain_contractText52.zh: 多因素验证还没有开放。

chain_contractText57.en: Private key export isn't available yet.

chain_contractText58.en: Scan to pay isn't available yet; the camera won't open and no payment code is generated here.
chain_contractText58.zh: 扫码支付还没有开放，这里不会打开相机或生成收款码。

chain_contractText59.en: Bridge isn't available yet; no bridge action is started here.
chain_contractText59.zh: 跨链还没有开放，这里不会发起任何跨链操作。

chain_contractText6.en: Indicators and drawing tools aren't available yet.
chain_contractText6.zh: 指标与画线工具还没有开放。

chain_contractText60.en: DApp connection and signing aren't available yet; this page only runs local checks.
chain_contractText60.zh: DApp 连接与签名还没有开放，这一页只做本地检查。

chain_contractText7.en: Net value trend and 24h change can't be loaded right now.
chain_contractText7.zh: 净值走势与 24h 涨跌暂时读不到。

chain_contractText8.en: Custom networks aren't available yet; only networks LOOP supports are shown here.
chain_contractText8.zh: 自定义网络还没有开放，这里只显示 LOOP 支持的网络。

chain_contractText9.en: Security Center and DApp status aren't available yet.
chain_contractText9.zh: 安全中心与 DApp 状态还没有开放。

chain_contractTimedOut.en: LOOP timed out. Nothing was loaded on this page and no action was submitted.
chain_contractTimedOut.zh: LOOP 响应超时，这一页没有读到数据，也没有提交任何操作。

chain_contractUnavailable.en: On-chain data can't be loaded right now. Try again later.
chain_contractUnavailable.zh: 暂时读不到链上数据，请稍后再试。

chain_contractUnexpected.en: The action didn't finish. Try again later.
chain_contractUnexpected.zh: 操作没有完成，请稍后再试。

chain_contractValidationFailed.en: The input isn't valid (for example, an unregistered asset or an invalid threshold). Fix it and try again.
chain_contractValidationFailed.zh: 输入内容不符合要求（例如资产未登记或阈值非法），请修改后重试。

chain_contractVersionConflict.en: The data was changed on another device. Reload before submitting; nothing was overwritten this time.
chain_contractVersionConflict.zh: 数据已被其他设备修改。请重新加载后再提交，本次没有覆盖任何内容。

chain_widgetsChainPreviewNoticeBody.en: {resource} exists only in this development preview; it isn't written to your account or uploaded.
chain_widgetsChainPreviewNoticeBody.zh: {resource}只存在于这次开发预览里，不会写入账号，也不会上传。

chain_widgetsRegionBlocked.en: {chainFailureReason} Content already loaded on this page isn't affected.
chain_widgetsRegionBlocked.zh: {chainFailureReason}本页已读到的内容不受影响。

chain_widgetsStepUpRequired.en: {chainFailureReason} Check the verification methods available in Security Center; content already loaded on this page isn't affected.
chain_widgetsStepUpRequired.zh: {chainFailureReason}请到安全中心查看当前可用的验证方式；本页已读到的内容不受影响。

chain_widgetsSwitch.en: {chainFailureReason} This permission can't be changed in the app. You can switch to an authorized account or asset; content already loaded on this page isn't affected.
chain_widgetsSwitch.zh: {chainFailureReason}这项权限不能在应用里自行调整；可以换一个已获授权的账号或资产，本页已读到的内容不受影响。

chain_widgetsTitle.en: This content isn't available right now

chain_widgetsTitle3.en: This action isn't available in your region
chain_widgetsTitle3.zh: 当前地区不能执行此操作
